verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's product surface includes a dedicated 'Flows' report (referenced alongside funnels/retention in the MCP docs) plus messaging about diagnosing drop-off points and calibrating user journeys, which together describes path analysis before/after a key event. Missing for 10: a dedicated docs page explaining the Flows report UI/mechanics in depth and independent/hands-on confirmation of its path-exploration usability.
